$schema: LearnLab cast — reusable across chapters and grades.
_notes: These characters appear in chapter narration ('Aarav noticed…', 'Ms Priya asked…').
Cast is intentionally diverse across regions and gender so chapters can reach naturally for someone with relevant context (e.g. Kashi from Rajasthan for desert; Pema from Sikkim for mountains).
Avatar paths are placeholders — real illustrations to be commissioned. Until then renderer shows a coloured initial circle.
These names are original to LearnLab; do not match NCERT cast.

characters.name: Ms Priya
characters.shortBio: The Grade 6 science teacher. Patient, asks questions instead of giving answers.

characters.name: Dadi Leela
characters.shortBio: A neighbourhood elder who's lived in many parts of India. Knows local plants and animals by name.

characters.name: Aarav
characters.shortBio: Curious, asks 'why?' a lot. City kid.

characters.name: Diya
characters.shortBio: Quiet, careful observer. Sketches what she sees.

characters.name: Kabir
characters.shortBio: Knows the desert well — talks about home a lot.

characters.name: Tashi
characters.shortBio: Grew up in the mountains. Knows snow and cold like Kabir knows sand.
